subject: Runbook & architecture session — scheduling and one reschedule

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Runbook & architecture session — proposed windows

Hi Pablo —

Thanks again for the discovery call last week — appreciate the context on inference volume and compliance constraints. Per our conversation, we'd like to schedule a joint runbook + architecture review so we can:

- Walk the proposed serving topology and failover patterns
- Align on prefix/KV cache strategy and quantization tradeoffs for your models
- Draft the runbook for cutover and incident playbooks (SLOs, alerting, rollback)

Proposed 90–120 minute windows (PT):
- Wed 4 Nov, 13:00–15:00 PT
- Thu 5 Nov, 09:00–11:00 PT
- Thu 5 Nov, 14:00–16:00 PT

If your CTO prefers a shorter session we can split into two focused 60-minute blocks (architecture + runbook). Attaching a short draft runbook and proposed agenda so you can share with the team.

Can you confirm which of the above works and whether you want any of these items emphasized?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0147

Attachments: runbook-draft.pdf (5 pages, PDF)

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the options and the draft — useful. Quick update on availability:

- I can make Wed 4 Nov 13:00–15:00 PT, but our CTO (cc'd as cto@logixhealth.com) has a board conflict then.
- Our CTO has flagged Thu 5 Nov morning as preferred — 09:00–11:00 PT would be ideal for them.
- If Thu morning is not possible for Redwood's infra lead, we can do Thu 14:00–15:30 PT for a condensed session.

Also: a heads-up — our security lead wants a short pre-call checklist (SOC 2 evidence paths and data retention mapping). Would that be something you can cover or hand off to our solutions architect on the call?

Pablo

Hi Pablo —

Great, thanks for the quick turnaround and for including your CTO. Thu 5 Nov morning (09:00–11:00 PT) works for our team. To make that time high-leverage for an exec presence we suggest:

- 09:00–09:30 — exec summary + runbook highlights (high level, decisions needed)
- 09:30–10:30 — architecture walk-through (Soojin will lead on topology & cache strategy)
- 10:30–11:00 — ops runbook details / cutover checklist (Ben will cover alerts/SLOs)

Soojin and Ben — can you confirm you can make Thu 5 Nov 09:00 PT and that you have the infra lanes covered?

Pablo — attaching an updated agenda that calls out the security checklist items your team asked for. We'll also include a short appendix with SOC2 artifacts we typically surface (evidence types and where they live). If you'd like, I can send the appendix in a separate doc ahead of the call for your security lead to review.

If that plan looks good I'll send a calendar invite with a Zoom link and an ICS for your scheduler.

Best,
Marissa

Confirmed. I can cover alerts and SLO mapping on Thu 5 Nov 09:00 PT. Soo, can you confirm you'll lead the topology and KV cache sections? I’ll bring the ops playbook snippets and the incident rollback matrix.

Also: small note — our dedicated infra engineer (Amira) is on-call Thu morning but can join for the Q&A / cutover checklist if needed (30 min). If the CTO wants full deep-dive time with engineers, we can extend the session by 30 min at the end; otherwise the appendix should suffice for the board-level pass.
